representation_contract.canonical: static page.md, written at build-finished by generate_markdown_files()
representation_contract.convenience: browser Turndown over the live DOM, used by Copy in its default mode

surfaces.ASK_AI: sends the static .md URL (canonical); an external provider cannot fetch a blob: URL
surfaces.COPY: browser-generated by default (convenience), switchable to the static .md (canonical)

representation_contract.rule: Canonical means exactly one thing: the build-time artifact. A browser conversion is never canonical, however good it is, because no external agent can fetch it.

upstream_position.rationale: The assistant already generates static page.md and llms.txt itself at build-finished, so neither the NVIDIA vendored package nor the _sphinx_llm wrapper is required for any assistant surface. Measured: 0 references to _sphinx_llm in __init__.py, _static/ai-assistant.js, _static/__init__.py or any test; all 19 files mentioning it are documentation.
upstream_position.dependency_effect: Freezing _sphinx_llm removes hard module-scope imports of sphinx, docutils and sphinx_markdown_builder. The assistant keeps zero module-scope non-stdlib imports; bs4/markdownify stay optional and find_spec-gated, Turndown stays vendored inline.
